items.title_orig: Gen-X: Who Did You Know Before They Were Semi-Famous or Famous?
items.article_text:
I'm not a huge social media guy. I've been playing with ChatGPT and basically testing it as my typist. Stories are mine—the robot just makes them readable.
 Got me thinking: who did you know before they were semi-famous or famous?
 First for me was Mark Povinelli. In 1976 I was in 4th grade, he was in kindergarten, and his sister was in my grade. Every morning I'd see him heading into class carrying an old yellow Pee-Chee folder. He later became an actor in Water for Elephants, Nightmare Alley, Modern Family and others. Back then, he was just Mark.
 And now for my huge hypocritical brag:
 Stone Gossard — Stoney — school friend. Soon after getting my license, I drove my dad's yellow Honda Gold Wing with Stoney in the sidecar. Long before Pearl Jam.
 Emily Jenkins / E. Lockhart — school frie
